sources.entry: Hermes Agent *(NousResearch)* — The self-improving AI agent. Builds reusable skills from experience and improves them during use, giving it a compounding learning loop. Persistent cross-session memory (SQLite + FTS5), multi-platform gateway (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, CLI), 40+ built-in tools, and RL/trajectory-generation support via Atropos. One-line install. MIT. → Website · awe

summary.one_liner: A web UI workspace (chat, files, memory, skills, MCP, terminal, dashboard, and tmux-backed agent swarm) that pairs with a Hermes Agent gateway or any OpenAI-compatible backend.
summary.what_it_does: Hermes Workspace is a browser-based control panel for Hermes Agent, NousResearch's agent. It provides real-time SSE chat with tool call rendering, multi-session support, and markdown/syntax highlighting. It includes browsers and editors for agent memory and skills (the README cites 2,000+ skills with a marketplace), an MCP page, a workspace file browser with Monaco editor, and a cross-platform PTY terminal. It also offers an Operations dashboard with agent profile presets, a Conductor for mission dispatch, and a Swarm Mode that runs persistent tmux-backed Hermes Agent workers with role-based dispatch and a Kanban task board. It talks to two services: the Hermes gateway on port 8642 for chat and the dashboard on port 9119 for sessions, skills, config, and jobs. Without those, it runs in a "portable mode" against any OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama or LM Studio.
use_cases: Chat with a self-hosted AI agent from a browser
Browse and edit agent memory and skills
Run a multi-agent swarm with task board and review gates
Control a Hermes Agent from a phone over Tailscale
Use a local Ollama or LM Studio model through a web chat UI
Manage MCP servers and agent sessions from one dashboard
how_to_run: curl -fsSL <installer URL> | bash  (one-line install; URL missing from README text)
git clone <repo> && cd hermes-workspace && pnpm install && cp .env.example .env
Set HERMES_API_URL and HERMES_DASHBOARD_URL in .env, then pnpm dev
docker compose up  (pulls nousresearch/hermes-agent and ghcr.io/outsourc-e/hermes-workspace images)
notable: Zero-fork design: runs on vanilla NousResearch/hermes-agent with no custom fork required
Conductor falls back to a Workspace-native Swarm dispatch when the dashboard mission API is absent
Works in portable mode with any OpenAI-compatible backend, not only Hermes Agent
Installable as a PWA with Tailscale access from phones
Built-in auth middleware, path-traversal guard, and fail-closed remote bind requiring a password
caveats: Full features need both the Hermes gateway (:8642) and dashboard (:9119) running; otherwise sessions, memory, and skills show 'Not Available'
Native Electron desktop app and cloud/hosted version are listed as in development or coming soon, not shipped
Remote access requires setting API_SERVER_HOST and HERMES_PASSWORD, and some Docker setups need cookie and proxy env tweaks
